caption: The drawing features two objects placed against a plain, light beige background. On the left side of the image, there is a brown, V-shaped mask with a textured surface and slightly curved sides, attached to a wavy, brownish-beige strap that appears to be tied or secured with string at each end. On the right side, there is a pair of goggles with two large oval eye openings, brown in color, showing darker shading inside the eye spaces, and outlined by a slightly reddish accent at the top. The goggles are also attached to a similarly colored, wavy strap, fixed with a thin string at both sides. Both straps have a fabric-like texture and the strings are depicted with fine, thread-like lines. The objects are separated by some space, with the mask positioned above and to the left, and the goggles located lower and to the right.
title: Eye Shades
